messages.subject: Some comments on <http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/stat_.html>
parts:
Dear GGplot folks,


reading through the documentation [1] I think I found some typos and I
hope I am not mistaken.

[…]

To make sense in a graphic context a stat must be
location-scale.

location-scale*d*?

That is, f(x + a) = f(x) + a and f(b x) = b f(x). This ensures
that the transformation is invariant under translation and
scaling, common operations on a graphic.

If f is a function I know that property as linearity [2]. It would be
nice to mention what f is supposed to be.


Thanks,

Paul


[1] http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/stat_.html
[2] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linear
